entity_info.name: NVIDIA Corporation
entity_info.description: NVIDIA-specific concept mappings for custom XBRL extensions, including CapEx (2013–2021 combined PPE + intangibles line).

concept_mappings._comment_nvda_capex: 2013–2021: NVDA combined PPE and Intangible Assets into one SCF line and used custom extension elements. 2022+: uses us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets. 2010–2012: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment. 2008–2009: pre-mandate/early XBRL.

business_context.description: NVIDIA Corporation designs and sells graphics processors and related software.
known_issues: CapEx 2013–2021: combined PPE + intangibles line tagged with custom extension (nvda:PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndIntangibleAssets or similar); parser must accept extension elements by local name.
CapEx 2008–2009: XBRL not mandatory or early taxonomy; data may be missing.
